projects.title: BankGuard Nexus
projects.description: An AI-powered banking fraud detection and security system designed to identify phishing messages, malicious links, suspicious OTP activity, and scam-call threats.
projects.problem: Phishing scams, fake URLs, and social engineering OTP hijacks bypass traditional rule-based defenses and lead to immediate financial drain.
projects.solution: Built a centralized security decision engine parsing message bodies, checking URLs against dynamic blocklists, and computing threat scoring in real time using local ML classification.
projects.impact: Mitigates zero-day phishing links and automated text scams prior to transaction processing gateways.

steps: Centralized security decision engine triggers BLOCK + ALERT

projects.results: Correctly detected 97% of mock banking phishing payloads and flagged malicious URL redirects in less than 350ms.
projects.futureScope: Deploy localized LLMs to model context of incoming phone scam transcripts in real time.
projects.securityAspects: AI threat detection, SMS analysis, OTP security, malicious URL detection, threat scoring, centralized decision engine

projects.title: CloudShield
projects.description: Secure cloud file storage architecture using AWS security services and encrypted access controls.
projects.problem: Uncontrolled public access, lack of server-side encryption, and static long-term access credentials expose cloud-hosted file repositories to leaks and access violations.
projects.solution: Designed a secure cloud storage pattern using AWS S3 bucket policies to block public access, AWS KMS for customer-managed encryption keys, and IAM roles to restrict write access. Temporary access is generated via secure short-lived S3 Pre-signed URLs.
projects.impact: Demonstrates practical execution of the Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) and secure key rotation strategies in cloud infrastructure.

steps: Generate pre-signed S3 download URL (Express Backend)
Retrieve object with AES-256 decrypted keys (AWS S3 & KMS)

projects.results: Configured 100% encryption-at-rest with automatic S3 block-public-access controls and short-term IAM access role isolation.
projects.futureScope: Integrate automated malware scanning on file uploads using an AWS Lambda function integrated with ClamAV.
projects.securityAspects: IAM least privilege, KMS key rotation, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, pre-signed URLs, CloudTrail audit logs

projects.title: Sentinel AI
projects.description: A futuristic AI security assistant designed for threat analysis, security alerts, suspicious activity monitoring, and security recommendations.
projects.problem: Security analysts are overwhelmed by massive logs streams, leading to delayed detections and unmonitored lateral movements.
projects.solution: Engineered a local interface integrating lightweight parser scripts and token analyzers to scan input logs and output prioritized severity alerts.
projects.impact: Reduces investigation times by pre-categorizing logs and presenting proactive system hardening steps.

steps: System log parser checks active endpoints
AI anomaly scanner spots lateral movements
Alerts sent via secure communication socket connection

projects.results: Tested log parsing templates on mock system access trails, locating 95% of simulated malicious connections.
projects.futureScope: Integrate with eBPF hooks for direct kernel-level threat isolation.
projects.securityAspects: Threat analysis, security alerts, suspicious activity monitoring, security recommendations, AI-assisted investigation

projects.title: Secure Task Manager
projects.description: A collaborative task management application featuring hardened backend logic, role-based access control, and protection against common OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
projects.problem: Typical productivity tools focus on usability and lack data security, exposing tasks and credentials to unauthorized modification, SQL injections, and session hijackings.
projects.solution: Built a multi-user dashboard utilizing secure JWT storage, password hashing via bcrypt, sanitized request routing to block scripting injections, and express rate-limiting to mitigate brute-force attempts.
projects.impact: Successfully established a secure coding workflow applying defensive controls directly during application bootstrap.

steps: Auth Gate: Validates JWT access parameters
DB Layer (MongoDB): Stores hashed credentials and encrypted tokens

projects.results: Maintained secure operations across simulated brute-force logins and input injection tests. Mitigated 100% of standard script insertion payloads.
projects.futureScope: Incorporate OAuth2.0 authentication flows and biometric MFA protocols.
projects.securityAspects: JWT authorization, bcrypt password hashing, request sanitization, Express rate-limiter, OWASP security practices

ideas.title: AI-Powered Real-Time Threat Audit Node
ideas.problem: Small scale developers lack tools to parse web server log files in real-time, leaving them open to SQL injections or slow-rate scraping.
ideas.concept: A lightweight background audit daemon that streams Apache/Nginx logs, checks against signature databases, and forwards hooks to Discord/Slack channels.
ideas.impact: Democratizes server logs monitoring for students and independent builders.

ideas.title: Zero-Knowledge Academic Certificate Verifier
ideas.problem: Manual verification of academic certificates is slow and prone to forgery.
ideas.concept: A student repository that hosts cryptographically signed hashes of academic transcripts, allowing instantaneous checking without revealing private student logs.
ideas.impact: Strengthens student project validation while maintaining user privacy.
